screens: Settings > AI agent > Agent recommends products

en: Can the agent recommend related products?
How do I turn off product suggestions in chat?

steps: Settings > AI agent > switch Agent recommends products (off for stores that existed before 2026-11-17 until the merchant turns it on; on for new stores; one-line explanation next to the switch)
The agent calls recommend_products only when the customer asks for ideas, alternatives, a complement or a budget, or once after an order
Cards are built from the Store's own recommendation engine (curated, AI, bought-together, similar), re-read live: active, public, in stock, price from the Store
At most 3 suggestion sets per customer per 24 h, one per turn, never the same product twice in 24 h
edgeCases: Window closed: the agent does not answer, so nothing is suggested (no template nudge yet)
Store bridge down: the model is told store_unavailable and answers in text
Nothing in stock / nothing similar: the agent says so plainly, no invented products
Merchant switched off Store automatic recommendations: curated picks only
Catalogue not synced to Meta: text answer with names, prices and links instead of cards
gaps: No proactive 'you might also like' after an order outside the 24 h window (needs an approved template)
